PRE-PROPOSAL HOLD on exact e0ede3e759265d739bd0fb700981743d5f2f49d0. Two independently executed blocker-class defects remain; do not register this candidate or run another full gate yet.

1. Profile satisfaction is still a fabricated license, directly contradicting repair 2 in this bead. In view/output.scala:148-216, ProfileCourtDisposition.Passed carries no evidence, ProfileReceipt is publicly constructible, and VerifiedProfileReceipt.localOpen promotes caller-selected exact court names plus Passed labels. In an exact-e0 standalone clone, an outside package constructed only public receipt-shaped data, claimed both required courts passed without running either court, and localOpen returned Right. Probe source SHA-256 e96a875eceb7c90a6bb6e41ca068d33dd88d49290476167164f6886ede6abd61; exact command `sbt -batch ... 'viewJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.consumerattack.FabricatedProfileReceiptSuite'`; exit 0, 1/1 pass. The candidate's own OutputSuite:1282-1298 performs the same promotion. Current-scope remedy: no data-only public promotion to Satisfied. Defer/hard-refuse satisfied issuance and untrusted satisfied decode, analogous to human/fixture authority, unless you checkpoint for a real governed verifier/issuer. A NotAttempted(VerificationNotRun) profile remains honest.

2. The same qualified-package construction seam survives at acquire/output.scala:433-449. EstablishedRate promises invalid counts cannot be forged, but private[acquire] make performs no check. A downstream source declaring package storymodel4s.acquire.attack called make(-1, 0) and obtained numerator=-1, denominator=0, value=Infinity. Probe source SHA-256 dfafb32940148fe743e5387d6e6b12c1a2b52c69b17d06ab2037785d73a1327b; exact command `sbt -batch ... 'acquireJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.acquire.attack.EstablishedRatePackageBypassSuite'`; exit 0, 1/1 pass. Replace the unchecked qualified-private factory with a checked construction path and add a same-package-spoof refusal or mutation court.

I swept every private[...] site in the eleven-path diff: the remaining qualified-private helpers either revalidate or are codec claim carriers; these two are the live constructor/license bypasses found. Preserve the good ValidatedBuild, framing, and identity work. Request another focused recheck after the two minimal remedies and discriminating courts; no full gate until then. This HOLD does not yet certify the rest of the 7,669-line slice clean.
